sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:3

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:3:1
items.html: The vessels that had descended in Beria also ascended above, into Atzilut: He informs us that the ascent of the lights, meaning of the records in the correction of the MAN, corrects together with them their vessels as well, in the very measure in which the records themselves were corrected in this ascent. For the records always receive the correction of the vessels along with them. And this is what he says: when the seven lights ascended above, the vessels that had descended in Beria also ascended above, into Atzilut.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:3:2
items.html: But they did not join together: That is to say, although the place of the records is in their own vessels, and although the vessels have already received a correction through them, enabling them to ascend into Atzilut, as above in the adjacent item, nevertheless the records are still unable to clothe in their vessels. This is because the records themselves have not yet received their complete correction through that raising of MAN, for they still require the couplings called the months of Ibur, whose matter will be explained in its place. And through the records’ staying there in the womb of Bina, they receive there all the MAD [male waters] from the couplings of Ibur, and they are corrected completely, and then they clothe in their vessels.
